symptom: `create external entities` from an OData v4 contract with Product.Category → Category named the association `Integ.Category_2`, a suffix suggesting a clash nothing in the module explained.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_contract.go uniqueAssocName (now takes the parent entity). Test: mdl/executor/external_assoc_name_2354_test.go
cause: Associations are named after the navigation property; `Category` collides with the entity Category (CE0065 forbids it), and the only fallback was a numeric suffix.
insight: **A collision fallback should add meaning, not a counter.** `<Parent>_<NavProperty>` is unique wherever the parent is and reads as the Mendix convention; a counter depends on import order. Re-import dedup matches by RemoteParentNavigationProperty, so existing suffixed names are left alone (verified: second run 0 created, 1 association). Measured on 11.12.6: Integ.Product_Category, mx check 0 errors.
